Our services

Pest and rodent control, done properly

Insects can damage your home's foundation and your family's health — or just be a nuisance. Our services cover the pests Snohomish County homes actually face.

Pest Service

Ants, spiders, cockroaches, wasps and hornets, fleas and more — comprehensive protection for your home, inside and out.

Rodent Service

Trapping and exclusion for rats and mice, preventing the damage they can cause to your home and your health.

Premium Service

Our Pest and Rodent services combined — the highest level of protection for your home and place of business.

Ants

Ants trail through kitchens and patios in search of food. We trace the trail to its source and treat it there.

Spiders

Spiders build webs in garages, eaves and quiet corners. We find what attracts them and close the gaps they use.

Fleas

Fleas persist in carpets, shaded yards and shared spaces. We check likely harborage areas and outline a targeted plan.
